rundown: United beat Phoenix 102-95. United led 64-39 at the half and never looked back. The 2nd quarter decided it: United won it 34-17.
Leading the way — Phoenix: Nathan Sobey 23 pts, 8 ast; Yannis Morin 7 reb. United: Cole Anthony 39 pts; Joe Ingles 5 ast; Sam Waardenburg 10 reb.
Where United won it: they shot 50% to 40% and won the boards 47-34.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 14, 3:26 AM ET. It had Phoenix 47% and United 53%, projecting Phoenix 97.3 – United 98.2 (195.4 total, United by 0.9).

Final: Phoenix 95 – United 102. Right winner: it had United at 53%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Phoenix came in with a 4% above average attack and a 3% leakier than average defense (4-8, 98.2 scored and 97.8 allowed a game over 12 games), worth about 8 and 8 games of evidence. Projected to score 97.3, they scored 95 (−2.3 points, 2% under); projected to allow 98.2, they allowed 102 (+3.8 points, 4% over).

United came in with a league-average attack and a league-average defense (7-6, 98 scored and 91.7 allowed a game over 13 games), worth about 8 and 8 games of evidence. Projected to score 98.2, they scored 102 (+3.8 points, 4% over); projected to allow 97.3, they allowed 95 (−2.3 points, 2% under).

The bigger miss was United's scoring (+3.8 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 197 against 195.4 projected (+1.6), about the 54th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±16).

Margin: United by 7 against United by 0.9 projected, about the 69th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: there were no odds to check the projection against.

The projection landed within its normal range anyway, so the flags didn't cost it much this time.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.013 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +4.9 points. It counts toward Hoops+ scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 47 graded Hoops+ games the algo now scales scoring ×1.005 and gives home teams -1.2 points. Team corrections so far: Phoenix attack ×1.006, defense ×1.025 (3 games); United attack ×1.014, defense ×1.007 (3 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
